feeds.description: Contemporary art space located in the heart of Williamsburg, Brooklyn specializing in pop-culture, gig and alternative movie posters.

feeds.title: Charles Fazzino Blog
feeds.description: Blog by Master of 3D Pop Art Charles Fazzino. He is a graduate of the School of Visual Arts in New York City & is one of the most popular and highly-collected pop artists of all time. During his more-than-thirty years as a pop artist, he has inserted his unique, detailed, vibrant, and three-dimensional style of artwork into the very fabric of popular culture.

feeds.title: Lew Stringer Comics
feeds.description: I am Lew Stringer. I have been working as a freelance artist and writer in British humour comics professionally since 1983. Clients include D.C. Thomson, Egmont, Marvel UK, IPC, Panini UK, Dark Horse Comics, Image Comics, and many more.

feeds.title: Kumi Contemporary Blog
feeds.description: Kumi Contemporary, situated in London, serves as a premier gallery for Contemporary Japanese Art, spotlighting renowned artists like Takashi Murakami and Chiho Aoshima. It proudly features works by innovative talents within the Japanese art scene. As a specialist Japanese gallery, Kumi Contemporary offers an extensive selection of Japanese Pop Art and facilitates the acquisition of Contemporary Japanese Art. Visitors can explore the Takashi Murakami print shop, showcasing a curated collection of his iconic works.

feeds.title: Lobo Pop Art Blog
feeds.description: Meet the Brazilian Plastic Artist Lobo. Custom Frames, Murals, and a lot of Pop Art! Biography, Exhibitions and Works. Pop Art Brazilian!

feeds.title: Stefanie Pop Art
feeds.description: I grew up and live in Chicago, and graduated College from Ball State University in Art & Design 22 years ago. My Pop Art is inspired by my friend the late great Steve Kaufman, Andy Warhol, Roy Lichtenstein, and also Peter Max. Everything I create is hand painted original art, and comes with a COA from my art studio. You will find my Unique Pop Art Paintings in Top Collectors homes all over the country.

feeds.title: Bluethumb
feeds.description: Bluethumb is the leading online art marketplace for Australian artists to display and sell their work. Our online art gallery is the place for art enthusiasts to connect and buy original artwork direct from artists from across Australia. Our mission is to help Australia's artists get their artwork out of studios and on walls by connecting them with collectors all over the world.
